scriptText:
I. COLD PURGE

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a cinematic sci-fi quarantine thriller in which a contained airlock bay becomes the stage for a mercy-killing standoff: @actor1 as ROBERT (voice: @audio1), station commander; @actor2 as SARAH (voice: @audio2), chief of security; @actor3 as ARTHUR (voice: @audio3), contaminated engineer; @actor4 as SAMIRA (voice: @audio4), xeno-biologist — a slow, suffocating escalation of loyalty, fear, and cold-duty execution that ends in one irreversible purge.
[[/INTENT]]

[[LOGIC]]
Keep the bay geography locked: the isolation chamber and reinforced viewport sit upstage, the decompression console pedestal stays centered, Robert remains anchored at the purge lever, Samira holds the port flank, and Sarah holds the starboard flank. Preserve the 180-degree line so Robert always faces upstage toward Arthur and neither woman changes screen side except during the motivated crash into the starboard bulkhead. Track hand and prop state every beat: Robert’s right palm stays clamped on the lever, Samira’s grip on his forearm persists until she releases it, Sarah’s baton stays in play until it is struck aside, and Arthur’s palms remain on the acrylic until vacuum tears him away. Escalate the filament invasion continuously with no reset between shots. Each macro-state inherits the visible condition of the previous one — no teleporting, no posture resets, no wardrobe changes, no unmotivated camera flips.
[[/LOGIC]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Medium: Photoreal cinematic sci-fi, anamorphic lenses, clinical composition with restrained handheld energy
Palette: Cold green-white fluorescents, brushed steel, hazard yellow, arterial red strobe, oily black filaments with an iridescent sheen
Lighting: Failing overhead panels, hard shadow stripes from deck gratings, flicker blackouts, strobing red emergency wash through the final purge
Location: Sealed airlock prep bay with a gridded steel deck, hazard-yellow striping, reinforced acrylic viewport, quarantined decontamination chamber beyond
Wardrobe: Robert wearing a matte black commander’s compression-shell jacket with charcoal yoke panels, high collar, brushed-metal zippers, and small orange hazard chevrons at the biceps; Samira wearing an olive-green medical utility tunic, a black cross-body instrument harness, charcoal knee pads, and cobalt nitrile gloves; Sarah wearing a slate-navy tactical pressure vest over a black sleeveless undershirt, gray ballistic bracers, and a thigh-mounted magnetic stun baton; Arthur wearing a torn white-and-teal thermal EVA undersuit with an open collar, singed shoulder fabric, and black coolant tubing trailing from the waist
Styling/Makeup: Robert with a high-and-tight cut, sweat-sheened temples, scarred jaw; Sarah with a tight braid and faint burn discoloration on one cheek; Samira with damp hair pulled back and a biometric reader pressed to her temple; Arthur with waxy pale skin, a sweat-soaked hairline, and oily black filaments surfacing under the skin of his throat
Audio: Diegetic only, no music — mains hum, fluorescent flicker buzz, intercom-compressed voices, dull polymer impacts, metallic latch clicks, ionic hum, arc sizzle, klaxon, pneumatic purge, vacuum roar
VFX: Subdermal iridescent filament growth, high-voltage baton arcing, vacuum expulsion, persistent dark lipid smear on the acrylic
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
WIDE SHOT, slight high angle, camera at the starboard bulkhead looking across the decompression console toward the reinforced acrylic viewport. Hazard-yellow striping cuts diagonally across the gridded deck to the chamber threshold. Center frame, Robert stands in sharp profile at the steel pedestal, right palm clamped over the red purge lever’s safety latch, head angled upstage. Behind him, centered in the viewport, Arthur flattens both palms against the inner acrylic, chest heaving, black filaments pulsing at his open collar. Samira braces at the console’s port flank, frame-left, both hands wrapped around Robert’s forearm. Sarah stands at the starboard flank, frame-right, one hand resting on her thigh baton. Flickering clinical downlights cast a cold green-white wash; diagnostic readouts ripple at the console’s base; the chamber beyond the glass is dim, sterile, and still.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM 01] WIDE MASTER, slight high angle, camera at the starboard bulkhead looking across the decompression console toward the viewport -> [BLOCK] Robert at the center pedestal in sharp profile, right palm clamped on the safety latch; Samira frame-left on the port flank; Sarah frame-right on the starboard flank; Arthur centered in the acrylic upstage -> [ACT] overhead downlights stutter under a failing current -> [ACT] Arthur’s chest heaves, palms flattened against the inner pane -> [VFX] iridescent black filaments pulse in his open collar -> [ACT] Samira’s knuckles whiten as her grip shifts
[CAM 02] MEDIUM SIDE-ON, camera at chest height on the port flank, Robert in sharp profile frame-right, Arthur locked behind the viewport frame-left -> [ACT] Arthur slams both palms into the reinforced pane, once, then again -> <Dull, heavy polymer impacts> -> Arthur says, trembling, through the bay intercom {Telemetry’s holding baseline, Rob!} -> [BLOCK] Robert does not move; his eyeline stays fixed on Arthur through the glass -> Arthur says in a strained plea {It’s dormant — don’t lock the cycle!} -> [ACT] Robert’s jaw clenches until the masseter muscle bulges
[CAM 03] LOW-ANGLE MCU, camera at the console’s port edge looking up at Robert with Samira’s forearms cutting into the foreground -> [ACT] Robert shifts his weight -> [ACT] he snaps the purge lever’s safety latch open -> <Metallic click-clack> -> [ACT] Samira digs her nitrile-gloved fingers beneath Robert’s wrist, hauling back with her full body weight -> Samira says breathless {The cellular uptake is passive!} -> [ACT] her gaze darts between the flickering diagnostic telemetry and Robert’s unblinking profile -> Samira says, desperate {You vent him, you incinerate our only baseline!} -> [ACT] Robert’s hand curls tighter on the lever, knuckles blanching
[CAM 04] MEDIUM OTS, camera downstage of the console pedestal looking past Samira’s shoulder to Sarah, with Robert’s silhouette centered between them at the lever -> [ACT] Sarah draws a magnetic stun baton from her thigh sheath with surgical economy -> <Magnetic lock release> -> [ACT] she triggers the switch -> <High-voltage ionic hum> -> [ACT] she levels the arcing blue prongs at Samira’s carotid -> Sarah says with quiet authority {Clear the interface, Samira.} -> [ACT] Samira’s free hand braces the console edge; her shoulder dips, ready
[CAM 05] TELEPHOTO ECU, camera outside the bay looking through the reinforced acrylic, Arthur’s face and throat filling the frame -> [ACT] Arthur gags -> [ACT] a violent somatic tremor snaps his spine backward -> [VFX] black filaments surge beneath the skin, spider-webbing across his cheekbone toward his ocular cavity -> [ACT] his forehead slams into the inner acrylic -> <Sharp wet thud> -> [VFX] a dark, tar-like lipid smear streaks down the glass -> [ACT] Arthur’s fingers scrape down the pane, leaving thin trails
[CAM 04] -> [ACT] Sarah’s eyes narrow, reading the infection vector with chilling certainty -> Sarah says in flat command {It breached the cranial floor. Pull the lever, Commander.} -> [ACT] Robert’s free hand tightens on the console lip; the readout screens dim
[CAM 04] -> [ACT] Samira draws a sharp breath -> Samira says, desperate {No—!} -> [ACT] she releases Robert’s arm -> [ACT] she throws her whole torso across the console into Sarah’s weapon arm -> [ACT] the stun baton strikes the steel housing -> <Arc-flash and acrid sizzle> -> [VFX] blue sparks scatter across the shattered telemetry screens -> [CAM] whip-pan along the console -> [ACT] both women crash against the starboard bulkhead in a tangle of gear
[CAM 03] -> [BLOCK] Robert remains at the pedestal, gaze fixed on Arthur; Samira and Sarah are crumpled at the starboard bulkhead just out of frame -> [ACT] Robert does not glance at the scuffle -> [ACT] with single-minded, mechanical motion, he drives the purge lever down into its locked socket -> <Heavy ratchet slam> -> [ACT] his palm stays clamped on the lever, knuckles white
[CAM 02] -> [ENV] the bay klaxon shrieks -> <High-pressure pneumatic purge hiss> -> [ENV] the ambient bay plunges into strobing red emergency light -> [BLOCK] Robert still at the pedestal in profile, lever locked down; Samira and Sarah caught in a heap at the starboard bulkhead; Arthur’s silhouette still pressed to the glass upstage -> Robert says flat {Bay purged.} -> [ACT] red strobes sweep across Robert’s face as the chamber vents
[CAM 05] -> [ENV] the outer airlock seals crack like thunder -> [ACT] the outer doors rip open into the vacuum -> [ACT] Arthur is wrenched backward off the acrylic, limbs flailing, receding into the black void -> [VFX] the filaments flare into frozen threads as vacuum takes him -> [ACT] his fingertips tear from the glass, leaving the dark lipid smear behind -> [ENV] empty chamber, strobing red, one low hum
[</BRIEF>]
